Alignment.title: Alignment
Alignment.description: Pose of one scan in the group's slice plane: CCW yaw, then translate (offsetX, -offsetZ).

AlignmentHistoryEntry.title: AlignmentHistoryEntry
AlignmentHistoryEntry.description:
One past save, newest first (GET /api/groups/{name}/alignment/history) -- a snapshot
taken right before that save overwrote group_alignment.json, so it's always restorable.

FloorPayload.title: FloorPayload
FloorPayload.description: App floorplan.png as a data URL + where it sits (== studio.floorplan.FloorPlan.payload()).

LayerPayload.title: LayerPayload
LayerPayload.description: One scan in the workspace: slice cells (base64 uint8 codes, row 0 = min y) + pose + metrics.

PoseRequest.title: PoseRequest
PoseRequest.description: Body of POST .../metrics and .../icp: one scan at a candidate pose, other scans' current poses.

ProcessStarted.title: ProcessStarted
ProcessStarted.description: POST /api/projects/{name}/process: a single scan starts the pipeline; a multi-scan zip becomes a group.

ProjectStatus.title: ProjectStatus
ProjectStatus.description: status.json (== studio.status.read_status); phase None = never processed.

SavedMetrics.title: SavedMetrics
SavedMetrics.description: What the page writes into group_alignment.json per scan (rounded subset).

SlicemapV1.title: SlicemapV1
SlicemapV1.description: slicemap-v1 file (merged.slicemap.json): base64 uint8 codes 0 unknown / 1 free / 2 furniture / 3 wall.
